column3: “Designate” renders “Assign for yourselves”; “through Moses” renders “by the hand of Moses.”
“state his case” renders “speak his words”; “in the hearing of” renders “in the ears of.”
“without premeditation” renders “without knowledge”; “beforehand” renders “from yesterday and the third day.”
“the one who is high priest” renders “the great priest who will be.”
NASB puts “that is, Hebron” in parentheses.
